name: Ghostly Delights
source:
Ghostly Delights is a visual novel in which you play as Cain, a ghost trying to teach his new apprentice Sasha about being a Ghost and a baker.

Cain has lost the motivation to keep being a baker and is on the verge of vanishing from the Underworld, when Lydia, the reaper, decides that teaching a new ghost how to be a baker would be a good way to help him find his will to continue existing.

[From [url=https://bosimba.itch.io/ghostly-delights]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Ghostly Delights》是一部视觉小说，你在其中扮演鬼魂凯恩，试图教他的新学徒萨莎如何成为鬼魂和面包师。

该隐失去了继续当面包师的动力，并濒临从地狱消失的边缘，这时收割者莉迪亚决定教一个新的鬼魂如何成为一名面包师将是帮助他找到继续存在的意愿的好方法。

[来自[url=https://bosimba.itch.io/ghostly-delights]itch.io[/url]]
